name: Add a trip manually: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10 is 10 days used

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2026-09-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2026-09-10 (data-testid=trip-exit)
Exactly one trip row (data-testid=trip-row) appears, for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10, showing 10 days
